approval_notes: See AMO_SOURCE_README.md in the uploaded source archive. Build with Node.js 26.0.0 and Yarn 1.22.22: yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive; yarn build:firefox. The popup uses a pinned Next.js build ID. Local web-ext validation reports 0 errors, 0 notices, and 10 warnings in bundled Next.js/React runtime chunks. Preferences remain local and no data is collected or transmitted.

release_notes.en-US: Fixes settings saving, custom CSS editing and application, title notifications, and repeated event handlers. Following and Hide For You now target identified Home tabs and leave other pages alone. Preserves existing sidebar and drawer controls, local-only preferences, and permissions.
